storylines.label: Claude Mods
storylines.latest_title: Claude Mods: Flipping the Harness Inside Out

prior_narrative.tldr: On Oct 1, Anthropic's Claude Code team published a guide to mods: hooks that ship inside plugins and run within a Claude Code session. On Oct 4-5, DeepSeek Harness added an experimental mods compatibility layer, which trade press framed as a challenge to agent lock-in.
prior_narrative.whats_new: Latent Space (Oct 21) argues Claude Mods is an early form of the "Attention Interface", flipping the agent harness from facing the machine to facing the human.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Mods are a plugin-level extension point, so a second agent runtime accepting the same format lowers the cost of moving mod-based workflows between harnesses.

status.detail: Claude Code mods have an official guide, an experimental DeepSeek Harness compatibility layer, and now an outside essay positioning mods as a new harness paradigm.

beats.headline: Claude Code mods guide: hooks shipped inside plugins
beats.summary: Walks through building a mod from an empty folder and two larger examples.

beats.headline: DeepSeek Harness adds an experimental mods compatibility layer
beats.summary: Alpha release, DeepSeek rejecting the "copying homework" charge, and a Digitimes read of it as an open-plugin challenge to lock-in.

beats.headline: Latent Space: mods flip the harness to face the human
beats.summary: Commentary on the design direction, not new product detail.

open_questions: Does the Harness compatibility layer run existing Claude Code mods unmodified, or only a subset of hooks?
Will Anthropic document mods as a stable cross-runtime format, or keep them Claude Code specific?
Does Anthropic ship mod surfaces that put the human, not the tool loop, at the center of the harness?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: If you build Claude Code mods, keep hook logic free of Claude-specific paths for now; test against the Harness alpha only on throwaway projects until its coverage is documented.

day_captions.fb19327de99e9d43: Digitimes frames the bridge plus Harness's open plugin architecture as a lock-in challenge; adds framing, not new compatibility detail.
